City of Encinitas
Youth Commission
AGENDA
SEPTEMBER 2, 2015 -
04:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.

2.

3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Commissioners Oath of Office conducted by Commission Secretary Crystal Roff
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Youth Commission. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the Commission Clerk. If at least two Commission Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
7.

8.
ACTION ITEMS
8A.
Youth Commission Chair and Vice-Chair
The Youth Commission by motion elect the FY2015-16 Chair and Vice Chair to serve a one-year term.
Agenda Item 8A. Election of Youth Commission Chair and Vice-Chair
8B.
Commission Member Resource Handbook
The Youth Commission receive, review and become knowledgeable with the Commission Member Resource Handbook content.
Agenda Item 8B. Commission Member Resource Handbook
8C.
FY 2014-2015 Youth Commission Work Plan and 2015-16 Youth Commission Calendar
1) Review the FY 2014-2015 Work Plan, 2) Review the FY2015-16 Youth Commission Calendar and select a date for a Commission Orientation Workshop special meeting and 2016 Youth Summit event.
Agenda Item 8C. Work Plan and Calendar
8D.
Youth Commission Participation in a City Educational Video Production
The Youth Commission select Youth Commissioner(s) to participate in the production of an educational video, which may be shown to school age youth or community organizations who tour the Encinitas Civic Center and wish to learn about general City of Encinitas governance and operations.
Agenda Item 8D. City Educational Video Production
